scripts.infra: docker compose up -d kafka kafka-init mongo
scripts.servicios: concurrently -n sim,proy,notif,repr,anal,sla,web "npm run dev -w simulador" "npm run dev -w proyector" "npm run dev -w notificaciones" "npm run dev -w reprogramacion" "npm run dev -w analitica" "npm run dev -w monitor-sla" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.servicios:sin-notif: concurrently -n sim,proy,repr,anal,sla,web "npm run dev -w simulador" "npm run dev -w proyector" "npm run dev -w reprogramacion" "npm run dev -w analitica" "npm run dev -w monitor-sla" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.servicios:sin-sim: concurrently -n proy,notif,repr,anal,sla,web "npm run dev -w proyector" "npm run dev -w notificaciones" "npm run dev -w reprogramacion" "npm run dev -w analitica" "npm run dev -w monitor-sla" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.start:sin-notif: npm run infra && npm run esperar && npm run servicios:sin-notif
scripts.start:sin-sim: npm run infra && npm run esperar && npm run servicios:sin-sim
scripts.reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --build
